headline: Wrong Turn Leads Stranger to Save 12 Children from Georgia House Fire
meta_description: A man's GPS error down Highway 114 in Georgia led him to spot a burning house and rescue 12 children from a devastating fire.
summary_short: A stranger's wrong turn became a lifesaving moment when Casey spotted smoke from a house fire in Georgia and helped rescue 12 children from the flames.
body:
A man named Casey was following his GPS down state Highway 114 south of Lyerly in Georgia's Chattooga County when the device took him off course—straight into an unfolding emergency. Seeing smoke rising in the distance, he made the split-second decision to investigate. What he found was a burning house belonging to James and Larita Burke, foster parents who were home with 11 children and one grandchild, some adopted and some in foster care. Acting as the sole first responder, Casey woke James Burke from his recliner with an urgent message: "Hey, you've got to get out of here. Your house is on fire." Together with Mr. Burke and his son, Casey helped evacuate all 12 people safely as flames consumed the entire structure, two cars, and everything inside.

Mr. Burke later reflected on the extraordinary timing. "He was on the wrong road. His GPS put him on the wrong path. He's never been down that path before, and he said he knew that something was bringing him down that road," Mr. Burke told Local 3 News. "When he saw the fire from the top of the hill, he knew he had to take action. I'm so thankful that he did."

The Burkes have fostered roughly 500 children throughout their lives, making their home a beacon of care in their community. Though the fire destroyed nearly everything they owned, the outpouring of support has been immediate and generous. The family is now searching for a rental unit large enough to house all 14 members while they rebuild, grateful that some brick walls survived the blaze. Their story reminds us that sometimes life's detours lead us exactly where we're meant to be.
quick_facts: Stranger named Casey spotted fire while lost on Highway 114 near Lyerly, Georgia
Rescued 12 children and one grandchild from burning house in single night
Foster parents James and Larita Burke have cared for approximately 500 children
Entire house and two cars destroyed; family seeking rental to rebuild
